records.statement: Yamaha's 2026 YZ450FX owner's service manual lists a 27.0 ° caster, 121 mm (4.8 in) trail and 1470 mm (57.9 in) wheelbase at 114 kg (251 lb) curb weight, with 300 mm (11.8 in) fork and 306 mm (12.0 in) rear wheel travel, a 4.8 N/mm fork spring and 56 N/mm shock spring, and 100 kPa (15 psi) tire pressures.
records.notes: Damping adjuster values are counted out from the start (fully turned-in/hard) position as printed. Spring rates, standard fork oil amount and standard shock length come from the tuning chapter; free lengths of the standard springs are not printed. The spec-chapter fork oil Quantity (left/right) and the tuning-chapter standard oil amount differ (e.g. 496.0 vs 290 cm³ in 2021-23); the manual does not say what each measures, so both are recorded as printed.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2026 YZ450FX owner's service manual lists no FI-setting or atmospheric-condition table in its tuning chapter; the printed fuel-system baseline is throttle body BHR1, idle 1900–2100 r/min, fuel line pressure 300–390 kPa (3.0–3.9 kgf/cm², 43.5–56.6 psi) and ignition timing 8.0–12.0 °/2000 r/min B.T.D.C.

values.Tuning chapter FI content: None: the tuning chapter (chapter 10) of this manual has only chassis settings (sprockets, tire pressure, fork and shock setting). No FI setting, injection/ignition map or jetting-by-conditions table is printed in the extract.

records.notes: Four-stroke EFI model: the tuning chapter has no fuel/ignition setting guidance. Elsewhere in the full manual (outside this extract), fuel and ignition maps are adjusted through Yamaha's Power Tuner smartphone app; that content was not transcribed here.

values.gearing_guidance: Lower the secondary ratio (fewer rear teeth) for courses with long straights and raise it for courses with many corners; set it so the engine reaches maximum revs toward the end of the longest straight without over-revving, matching the course section that most affects results.

records.notes: The manual does not tie spring choices to rider weight; it lists optional springs soft→stiff with part numbers and I.D. marks and gives symptom-based adjustment tables. Optional spring free lengths are not printed. Shock spring part numbers carry a color in parentheses (Blue/Black/Silver) as printed; the manual does not label that column, so it is recorded verbatim. Section columns in the symptom tables are Jump / Large gap / Medium gap / Small gap.
